summary.tldr: Stops regulations under the Impact Assessment Act from setting a minimum coal production capacity for a new coal mine.
what_it_does: Adds a rule to the Impact Assessment Act that regulations cannot set a minimum coal production capacity for a new coal mine designated under section 109.
summary.background: Section 109 of the Impact Assessment Act lets regulations be made about designated physical activities. This bill adds a limit for new coal mines under that section.
